description.zh:
访问配置名称。

格式：包含英文字母、数字或短划线（-）。

长度：最大32个字符。
description.en:
The name of the access configuration.

The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

The name can be up to 32 characters in length.

description.zh:
访问配置的描述。

长度：最大1024个字符。
description.en:
The description of the access configuration.

The description can be up to 1,024 characters in length.

description.zh:
初始访问页面。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，初始访问的页面地址。

该页面必须是阿里云控制台页面。默认为空，表示跳转到阿里云控制台首页。
description.en:
The initial access page.

When a Cloud SSO user uses the access configuration to access a member in your resource directory, the user is redirected to this page.

The page must be a page of the Alibaba Cloud Management Console. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the user is redirected to the homepage of the Alibaba Cloud Management Console.

description.zh:
会话持续时间。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，会话最多保持的时间。

单位：秒。

取值范围：900~43200（15分钟~12小时）。

默认值：3600（1小时）。
description.en:
The duration of the logon session.

When a Cloud SSO user uses the access configuration to access a member in your resource directory, the session can be active for a maximum of this duration.

Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 900 to 43200 (15 minutes to 12 hours).

Default value: 3600 (1 hour).

descriptions.zh:
关于访问配置的介绍，请参见[访问配置概述](~~266737~~)。

本文将提供一个示例，创建一个名为`ECS-Admin`的访问配置。
descriptions.en:
For more information about access configurations, see [Access configuration overview](~~266737~~).

This topic provides an example of how to create an access configuration named `ECS-Admin`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso create-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-name ECS-Admin --description This_is_an_access_configuration. --session-duration 3600 --relay-state https://cloudsso.console.aliyun.com --tags Value=example-string Key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
